WOW Parenting

Author: Dr. J. Arawindhan Ji

School and Family Working as One: Because Learning Ends at Home

A foundational handbook for contemporary parents navigating the balance between academic expectations and emotional wellbeing. WOW Parenting introduces actionable parenting styles, emotional bonding techniques, and co-schooling frameworks that help parents nurture their children’s predominant intelligences without creating stress or anxiety.

“School starts at Home, continues at School, and it should end at Home, easily. When parents and teachers share the same vocabulary of encouragement, the child blossoms naturally.”

Target Readers & Applications:

Parents of preschool, primary, and adolescent students.

Core Philosophical & Pedagogical Themes:

  • Happy Parenting and Power Parenting methodologies
  • Aligning family values with classroom learning
  • Understanding children’s emotional spectrum and developmental phases
  • Building high practical self-esteem without comparison
Publication Provenance & Availability

This title is maintained in active institutional circulation across ACHARIYA schools, retreat gatherings, and ConCardios leadership programs. External commercial bookstore links and formal national library deposit registrations are coordinated under the phase 5 external presence roadmap.
